limitations: All reference and found lengths are upper bounds, not proven minimum lengths.
Compression is analysis-only and reverified with the strict checker.
Pass@k is first-k empirical coverage, not the unbiased combinatorial estimator.
Token curves admit complete attempts in recorded order; no skipped expensive attempts.
Recorded token costs exclude prompt prefill, padding and batching overhead; equal generated tokens are not equal FLOPs.
Curves are censored by the saved number of attempts and their response caps.
Paired intervals resample targets, not independent training seeds or textbook sources.
A sprint-final-only partition does not erase historical benchmark exposure.
